title: Adobe Photoshop CC Advanced Training Course Introduction
summary: This short, 3- to 4-minute introduction video by Dan, an Adobe Certified Instructor, outlines the scope and selling points of the Bring Your Own Laptop Photoshop CC Advanced Training Course. It positions the course as a workflow-focused, project-driven program for experienced Photoshop users seeking faster, more efficient techniques. The overview enumerates modules on selection and masking, image correction for hard and blurry images, color and tonal adjustments, upscaling without distortion, object removal, distortion and reshaping effects, typography workflows, artboards for social media, advanced retouching, video and animation capabilities (parallax and Cinemagraphs), 3D in Photoshop, and reusable mock-ups. The video emphasizes real-world projects, downloadable exercise files, and class projects, with the aim of shaving hours off daily Photoshop tasks and expanding professional capabilities for users already familiar with Photoshop fundamentals.
topics: Trending visual styles: Duo Tones, glitches, color grading
Typography workflows: Typekit, font guessing, ligatures, variable fonts
Artboards and social media post sizing
Advanced retouching: healing, cloning, patching; teeth and eye corrections
Video editing in Photoshop; parallax and Cinemagraphs (Living Images)
Downloadable exercise files and class projects

sections.title: Course introduction and target audience
concepts: Audience: experienced users seeking faster workflows

sections.title: Selection techniques and masking focus

sections.title: Creative edits: generation and object removal

sections.title: Distortion, bending, and reshaping
sections.description: A personal favorite section is devoted to manipulating image geometry for creative effects.

sections.title: Visual styles and color effects

sections.title: Typography and font workflows
sections.description: Covers typography-centric features and smart font tools to streamline text integration in imagery.

sections.title: Artboards and social media formatting
sections.description: Demonstrates creating flexible, scalable layouts for different social platforms.

sections.title: Advanced retouching and facial corrections
